headline: Comparative genomics flags seven conserved structured ncRNA motifs in protists
label: Structured Noncoding Rna Analysis
summary: Recent preprints apply comparative and integrative methods to structured ncRNAs and sRNAs, while a Cell study links RNA folding to host mRNA partitioning.
synthesis: The common thread is computational analysis of RNA sequence and structure. A CMfinder and R-scape screen across protist genomes identifies seven candidate structured ncRNA motifs, with likely roles in photosynthesis. The aureoRNA preprint integrates phylogeny, public transcriptomes and computational predictions into an interactive atlas of Staphylococcus aureus sRNAs and their targets. Both preprints apply comparative and integrative methods, and their findings remain provisional. The published Cell study is less directly about ncRNA discovery: it reports that RNA folding drives species-dependent partitioning of host mRNAs into Ebola virus condensates, bringing structural considerations of RNA to host transcript localization.
